mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates labor market weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession fears dominate equity allocation decisions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and stable CPIAUCSL signals effective monetary policy without inflationary pressure, generating positive equity returns as real rates fall and risk appetite rises over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances meeting the dual condition.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising HOUST combined with GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive equity returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances meeting the dual condition.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering recessionary expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust consumer confidence and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as leading economic indicators strengthen.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% year-over-year inflation signals persistent price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, accelerating payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market resilience, driving positive equity returns as earnings growth expectations rise over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances meeting the dual condition.
